initialization: Select by E031 locked rule before running E032
hypothesis: Random temporal offsets and additional training improve deployed forecasts; a 2x2 design separates their effects.
gate: Against stride20/600, candidate must have fold-mean Rel-L2 gain >=0.15 and SPS gain >=0.5, with neither fold losing >0.10 Rel-L2, >0.25 TKE, >0.10 MVPE or >0.25 SPS. Confirm selected recipe and comparator with seed1 on both folds before refit.
sampling: Both grid and dense cells sample a trajectory uniformly and an available start uniformly with replacement. Dense starts are consecutive integers, grid starts are multiples of20. Equal trajectory weighting in all four cells.
selection: Among passing cells choose highest two-fold mean SPS; ties within0.1 prefer fewer updates then stride20. All evaluations use emaV and frozen bounds; no loss or inference change.
